source_transfer_integrity: Locally executed Python sources and JSON fixture matched immutable GitHub-created blobs byte-for-byte, verified by git hash-object and GitHub create_blob SHA

execution.environment: Local isolated Python 3.13.5 standard library, no network

negative_control_cases: Synthetic 403/404, absent target with and without authoritative absence, stale branch and target, unauthorized redirect, heading renderer unverified, private edges withheld, out-of-scope nodes, cycles, unknown dependents, partial enumeration, symlinked input refusal; no real broken link alleged.
scope_limitations: Offline checker consumes host-authored metadata; it does not independently authenticate viewer permissions, provider status, Git object integrity, branch rules, source completeness, slug conventions or real target existence.
Real public GitHub tree was inspected via connector separately from the Python checker, not fetched by the Python script.
No independent host agent using the original v1.0 vs current v1.1 skill was executed.
No actual unlink/rename, user-visible repair, provider ACL isolation or cross-tenant integration was performed.
Overall skill-effectiveness ratio >=1.5x NOT_PROVEN; previous static review 18/20 retained as historical, no inflated quality score.
